title: Conditions of Enrollment on the Extended Equipment Warranty Plans: Unit Age, Condition Inspection and Maintenance Agreement
content:
A unit is enrolled on one of the Extended Equipment Warranty Plans only where it is young enough and sound enough for the tier. The conditions are these.

## 1. Enrollment age

No unit may be older than the tier's enrollment age limit, counted in whole calendar months from the day the unit was installed to the quote day, a month completing on the day of the month matching the install day and, in a month without such a day, on that month's last day.

1.1 The clock starts on the day the unit was installed, as the equipment register records it for that unit.

1.2 The limit is the tier's enrollment age limit in calendar months. The limit is reached on the day the limit-th whole month completes; a quote day on or before that day satisfies the condition, and a quote day after it does not.

1.3 Whole calendar months are counted by the matching day of each following month; where a month has no such day, that month's count completes on its last day.

### Boundary cases on hypothetical dates

| Install day (register) | Tier | Limit | Day the limit-th month completes | Quote day | Condition |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 15 March 2021 | Parts & Labor Protection Plan | 48 months | 15 March 2025 | 15 March 2025 | Met — the unit is exactly 48 whole months old |
| 15 March 2021 | Parts & Labor Protection Plan | 48 months | 15 March 2025 | 16 March 2025 | Not met — the quote day is after the day the 48th month completed |
| 31 January 2023 | Manufacturer Warranty Registration | 12 months | 31 January 2024 | 31 January 2024 | Met — the first month completed on 28 February 2023, February having no 31st, and the twelfth on 31 January 2024 |
| 31 January 2023 | Manufacturer Warranty Registration | 12 months | 31 January 2024 | 1 February 2024 | Not met |

## 2. Condition inspection

A tier whose enrollment inspection requirement is set is quoted only where a condition inspection of the units is recorded as completed in the office records, and a unit the inspection reports as failing is not enrolled at any price.

2.1 What decides the condition is the office record of the inspection request for the building and its recorded outcome, consulted before the quote is written. A statement that an inspection took place is not the record.

2.2 A unit reported as failing by the inspection is not enrolled, at that tier or at any price.

2.3 The enrollment inspection fee is charged per unit when the inspection is performed and is not refunded if the owner then declines the quote.

## 3. Maintenance agreement

A tier that requires maintenance is quoted only where the building holds a maintenance agreement in active or pending renewal status.

3.1 The maintenance agreement record for the building, and its status, decide the condition; the two statuses that satisfy it are active and pending renewal.

## The tier figures the conditions turn on

Each condition reads the tier's own figure: the enrollment age limit in months, whether the enrollment inspection is required, the inspection fee per unit, and whether an active maintenance agreement is required. Each is the tier's own schedule figure under the Extended Equipment Warranty Plans, for the tier asked for.

## Conditions combined

| Unit within the age limit | Inspection required and recorded as completed, unit not failing | Maintenance required and agreement active or pending renewal | Enrolled |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes (or inspection not required) | Yes (or maintenance not required) | Yes |
| No | — | — | No |
| Yes | Required, not recorded as completed | — | No |
| Yes | Required, unit reported as failing | — | No |
| Yes | Yes (or not required) | Required, agreement in any other status | No |
